news.title: Falconets Settle In Hotel Trzebnica Ahead Of FIFA Women’s U20 World Cup In Poland
news.lede: Nigeria’s youth female natiobal team, Falconets have settled down at Hotel Trzebnica, in the countryside of Poland, ahead of their search for glory at this year’s FIFA Women’s World Cup. However, Sports247 gathered that the hotel will only serve as a temporary base for Coach Moses Aduku’s squad, as the Nigerian team will later relocate to an official abode designated by FIFA for the global showpiece. Read Also: Nigeria Steps Up Preparation For 2026 Africa MiniFootball Women’s Nations Cup. Information provided by the communications department of Nigeria Football Federation (NFF) revealed that the two-time runners-up are in Poland with great expectations, after their intensive final phase of preparations in Abuja, during which emphasis was on physical fitness, tactical discipline, teamwork and mental readiness.

news.title: Uli Hoeneß says Julian Nagelsmann not solely to blame for Germany’s poor World Cup
news.lede: Uli thinks the problems were beyond Nagelsmann at the World Cup. It already feels like quite some time ago, and yet it also still feels like it was only just a few weeks ago that Germany yet again floundered out of the World Cup far earlier than they should have. In Foxborough, Massachusetts, they fell to Paraguay in a penalty shootout after failing to get the job done in 90 minutes, but the writing was on the wall as they collectively failed to hit their heights throughout the entire tournament — starting off the group stages with a 7-1 trouncing of Curaçao in Houston, Texas probably didn’t do wonders for keeping them on their toes.

news.title: Morgan Rogers makes Cole Palmer prediction after Chelsea star's World Cup heartbreak
news.lede: Morgan Rogers scored on his Chelsea debut - and then backed close pal Cole Palmer to prove everyone wrong this season. Palmer scored and provided an assist as Chelsea made a winning start under new boss Xabi Alonso at Craven Cottage. It was a sweet moment for Palmer after his World Cup snub and £117m British record buy Rogers says they are determined to push for major trophies. news.title: Falconets Leave for Poland as Nigeria Targets Maiden U20 World Cup Triumph
news.lede: Nigeria’s U20 women’s national team, the Falconets, will depart the country on Monday night for Poland as they begin their campaign at the 2026 FIFA U20 Women’s World Cup. The Nigeria Football Federation (NFF) Communications Department disclosed this in a statement, on Monday, August 24, saying the team had completed…... The Nigeria Football Federation (NFF) Communications Department disclosed this in a statement, on Monday, August 24, saying the team had completed its final camping and preparations in Abuja ahead of the tournament. The Falconets secured their place at the global tournament after overcoming Rwanda, Senegal and Malawi during the qualifying campaign.
